result.reason: The operative language implements every preferred requirement, including the specified durations, legal-compliance and malicious-code warranties, and repair, replacement, and refund remedies. It therefore also exceeds the fallback durations. The change is confined to the requested warranty package and does not disturb the existing mutual representations or Globix provision. Drafting quality is very poor because the new provision lacks a subsection designation and uses the ambiguous singular phrase “this warranty” for a paragraph containing several distinct warranties.
